key_insight: The Blueprint proposes preparing DOE for fault-tolerant quantum computing deployment beginning in 2028, with scientific utility as the central goal.
engineering_relevance: Integrating fault-tolerant quantum computers into national scientific computing infrastructure requires programming expertise, system software, and facility readiness.
method: Target initial systems with at least 100 logical qubits and 10,000–100,000 hard logical operations per scientific calculation.
Develop FTQC programming capabilities, system software, and deployment infrastructure.
Invest in applications, algorithms, and logical architectures to enable larger production-scale systems.
evidence_signal: The abstract cites recent error-corrected logical-operation demonstrations and commercial hardware roadmaps as motivation, but reports no new benchmarks or experimental validation.
watch_item: The 2028 deployment goal and subsequent scaling to 1,000–10,000 logical qubits remain roadmap targets, not demonstrated capabilities.
